claims.statement: FileStorageService stores record files under <dataDir>/storage/<collectionId>/<recordId>, enforces maxSize and mimeTypes options, appends an 8-character random hex suffix on saveFile(), and validates path containment to prevent path traversal.

RealtimeService manages Server-Sent Events (SSE) clients with 25-second keepalive pings, topic subscriptions (*, <collection>, <collection>/<recordId>), and per-client RuleEngine.evaluate(collection.viewRule) checks before broadcasting record events.

WebhookService stores configurations in _webhooks and delivery logs in _webhook_deliveries, signs payloads with HMAC-SHA256 in X-NodeStack-Signature when a secret is set, and dispatches requests through SsrfGuard.createGuardedFetch().

SnapshotService manages up to 10 point-in-time snapshots in <dataDir>/.snapshots/ using MaintenanceGate.executeExclusive(), SQLite VACUUM INTO, storage directory copies, and deterministic SHA-256 content hashes for drift detection.

AuditLogService records afterCreate, afterUpdate, and afterDelete events in _audit_logs with field-level diffs while redacting password, passwordHash, tokenKey, secret, apiKey, and token fields to '[REDACTED]'.

LogService buffers HTTP request logs in memory (up to 50 entries or 250ms) before batch-inserting into _logs, and AnalyticsService aggregates database sizes, collection counts, connected SSE clients, and 24-hour hourly traffic metrics.
